cmd.title: Shortcuts & Siri
cmd.sub: Add to Family Hub by voice, from the Share menu, a widget or the Action button — without opening the app.
cmd.subAndroid: Some work right away, no setup. The rest your phone does by itself through the free MacroDroid app.
cmd.builtInHint: Family Hub just needs to be installed as an app (Chrome → ⋮ → «Install app»).
cmd.longPressSub: Groceries, Tasks, Budget, Inbox. Drag any of them to the Home screen.
cmd.shareToSub: From any app: a link or text goes to groceries, tasks, wishlist, Dates, recipes, the watchlist or music.
cmd.how1: Create a key below — shortcuts need it to write into your couple.
cmd.how2: Open a shortcut and repeat its steps in the Shortcuts app — it takes a minute.
cmd.how3: Run it: «Hey Siri, <shortcut name>», from a widget, the Action button or the Share menu.
cmd.enOnly: Shortcut instructions are in Russian and English for now.
